text: ほしい　ポケモンが　やっと　こうかんして　もらえたわ！

structure.jp: ほしい　ポケモンが
こうかんして　もらえたわ！

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: こうかんして　もらえたわ
patterns.explanation: て-form plus もらう says someone did something for you. もらえた is the can-do form, so it worked out. こうかんして　もらえた = 'I was able to get it traded'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A describing word placed right before a noun says what kind of noun it is. ほしい　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I want'.
